slides.title: Virtual AI Receptionist — Bukowy Dwór & Thermal SPA
slides.subtitle: Case Study: Enterprise Deployment of ElevenLabs Conversational AI in a Spa Hotel Chain — Deployment Strategist, 2026
slides.notes: Start with 30 seconds of pure business context, user demographics, and financial stakes before touching architecture.

slides.title: Senior Guests Wait. Front Desk Can't Keep Up.
bullets: Health Resorts & Thermal SPAs: 60–70% of guests are seniors (60+) — strong preference for phone calls over apps
Peak Inbound Waves: 8:00–10:00 AM & 4:00–6:00 PM create call queues, dropped calls, and severe guest frustration
Unanswered Call = Lost High-Margin Revenue ($30–$80 per spa treatment, $100–$250 per night)
Human Receptionist: ~$25/hr, available 8 hrs/shift, zero bandwidth for proactive pre-arrival outbound calls
slides.notes: Frame the problem from both guest empathy and hotel P&L perspectives before proposing technical solutions.

slides.title: Who Is Calling? Mrs. Sophia, 72 Years Old.
bullets_left: Speaks slowly, pauses mid-sentence to gather thoughts
Does not remember medical names — 'that spine treatment with warm mud'
Low error tolerance: hangs up immediately if interrupted or rushed
Demands SMS confirmation sent directly to her or her daughter's phone
bullets_right: Every single architectural decision stems directly from this user persona.
Not a generic persona — this is the true archetype of a thermal spa guest.
slides.notes: Every latency parameter, voice selection, and silence timeout is engineered around Sophia's cognitive and vocal traits.

slides.title: Meet Anna — Always Empathetic, 24/7
bullets: Powered by ElevenLabs Conversational AI: Unified Cloud Loop (STT + Orchestrator + TTS)
Sub-500ms real-time latency · Warm, measured cadence · 100% 24/7 availability
Omnichannel: Handles both telephone PBX calls and Interactive Web/Mobile Widget seamlessly
slides.notes: Show the 'what' and 'why' before diving into the live demonstration.

slides.title: 3 Core Architectural Decisions & Trade-Offs

bullets.text: Native ElevenLabs Agent vs. Cascaded Pipeline — Traditional STT→LLM→TTS cascades exceed 2.0s latency. Native loop achieves ~430ms. For seniors, latency equals trust.
TTS: Eleven v3 Conversational (not Flash) — Flash is fast (75ms) but robotic; v3 (~280ms) delivers human emotional warmth and intonation.
Acoustic Tuning: turn_timeout 3.0s, speed 0.85x, Patient Mode — Accommodates mid-sentence pauses without cutting off the guest.

slides.notes: Every choice was an intentional trade-off between pure benchmark speed vs. domain-specific guest conversion.

slides.title: Knowledge Base (RAG) — Zero Hallucination Policy
bullets_left: 5 Curated Markdown Knowledge Base Files (Access, Treatments, Rooms, Dining, Policies)
Prompt Mode (Constant Context): Standard pricing, cancellation rules, emergency policies
Auto Mode (Semantic Chunking): Comprehensive treatment descriptions, dietary details
Scales effortlessly to hundreds of documents without modifying agent code
bullets_right: Strict Grounding: Missing information triggers immediate warm transfer to human desk — never hallucinate
Mandatory Balneological Safety Check: Screen for cardiac and acute contraindications before booking
Hallucinated price = sales issue; Hallucinated medical advice = legal liability
slides.notes: Highlight safety and compliance. In medical wellness, a hallucinating AI is worse than no AI.

slides.title: Anna Doesn't Just Chat — She Executes Actions

rows: Checks available treatment slots in real time
Books appointment and generates confirmation code
Validates room inventory and calculates total stay price
Dispatches SMS/Telegram summary with booking ID
Initiates warm transfer to front desk or medical nurse

slides.notes: Explain how deterministic tool calling connects to existing hospitality software (PMS, CRM, Telco).

slides.title: Live Demonstration — 3 Key Interaction Flows
bullets: A. SPA Treatment Booking + Automated SMS Summary Dispatch (Happy Path)
B. Knowledge Base Inquiries (RAG strictly grounded in hotel policies)
C. Medical Escalation & Live Call Transfer to On-Duty Nurse (Safety Protocol)
Available live via the website widget and telephone SIP gateway
slides.notes: Run the live voice demo. Keep fallback JSON response screenshots ready if network latency spikes.

slides.title: Two Channels, One Cohesive Voice
bullets_left: Telephone (SIP Trunking): 24/7 pickup, 3.0s silence timeout, paraphrasing confirmation
Eleven v3 Warm Voice tailored for senior acoustics
Immediate SMS summary dispatched to guest or designated family member
bullets_right: Web/Mobile Widget: Floating branded FAB, interactive animated avatar state (Listening / Speaking)
Real-time streaming transcription + Multilingual Quick Reply Chips (PL, EN, DE, UK, ES)
Success booking summary card with one-click actions
slides.notes: Emphasize omnichannel synergy: the same agent core services both voice calls and website visitors without duplicated logic.

slides.title: Enterprise Security, Healthcare Data & GDPR
bullets: Zero Retention Mode (ZRM) — Audio streams and transcripts reside strictly in volatile RAM, zero disk storage
Conversation History Redaction — Automatic masking of PII (national IDs, phone numbers, addresses, health notes)
EU Data Residency — Compute, LLM inference, and vector embeddings located strictly within EU (Frankfurt / Dublin)
Signed URLs with 15-min TTL — Frontend widget connects securely without exposing backend xi-api-key
slides.notes: For healthcare and resort management, data compliance and privacy are mandatory requirements, not optional features.

slides.title: Multi-Tenant Scaling: 1 Core Agent, 10 Hotel Properties
bullets_left: The Challenge: 10 properties typically means 10 separate agents, 10 siloed knowledge bases, and linear maintenance costs
Configuration drift and operational overhead multiply rapidly
bullets_right: The Solution: 1 Master Agent Core + Dynamic Variables (hotel_name, location, reception_phone, pms_id)
SIP UUI (RFC 7433): Context metadata injected dynamically into the SIP signaling header per inbound number
Onboarding a new hotel requires updating metadata, zero prompt duplication
slides.notes: Demonstrate enterprise deployment maturity: sub-linear maintenance costs as hotel properties scale.

slides.title: Cost Efficiency & Hard ROI Breakdown
bullets: 275 minutes ≈ 1 hr of human receptionist wage ($22 vs $25) — immediate operational parity
AI Agent operates 24/7/365 with zero sick leave, zero call abandonment, and zero burnout
True ROI Driver: Capturing 5 high-margin after-hours bookings ($1,500+ revenue) pays for the entire monthly system in 48 hours
slides.notes: Do not frame AI as headcount replacement — frame it as an after-hours revenue capture engine.

slides.title: Implementation Roadmap — PoC → Phase II → Phase III
bullets: Phase I (MVP / Live Now): Standalone Conversational Agent, RAG grounding, Webhook Tool Calling, Live Web Widget
Phase II (Production Pilot): Full PMS two-way bi-directional sync (Opera Cloud / Mews), Twilio SIP Trunking, Multilingual routing (PL / EN / DE)
Phase III (Proactive AI): Outbound pre-arrival calls, shuttle coordination, medical questionnaire intake, personalized upselling
slides.notes: Phase III transforms the virtual assistant from a reactive call center into a proactive guest experience driver.
